title: Probability of a predicate on blocks
statement: Let $n,b\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $P$ be a predicate on functions from $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ to $\mathbb{N}$. The probability that a uniformly random Boolean word of length $nb$, divided into $n$ consecutive blocks of length $b$, has block values satisfying $P$ equals the number of functions $f:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\{0,\ldots,2^b-1\}$ satisfying $P$, divided by $2^{nb}$.
hypotheses_covered: A predicate on functions from $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ to $\mathbb{N}$
